images.alt: A ribbon marked like a measuring tape stands beside a tall young plant.
images.source: Editorial illustration on a calm Daylight background, wide panoramic (about 2.5:1, 1320x520), safe to crop to 4:3 around the right third. In the right third, a tall young plant built from flat faceted paper planes in navy and blue shades rises from a low faceted paper mound, its top leaves catching Ribbon Cyan light from the upper left. Beside its stem, a satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan stands upright like a gardener’s measuring tape, marked with plain, evenly spaced tick lines (lines only, no numbers or letters), running from the ground to the plant’s top leaf: growth that was measured. At the foot of the mound lies the small faceted paper seed husk it grew from. The left two thirds are calm, open Daylight with low, soft faceted hills along the bottom edge. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
images.note: The template’s default cover. A real case study may keep it or get its own cover made to the same rules; never a photo of the partner’s people or premises.

notes: Template only: every partner detail, result, date, quote and service list is a bracketed placeholder ([Partner name], [Industry], [Country], [Result], [Quote, approved by the partner], [Name], [Role], [date]); nothing is invented. The Info alert marks the frame as a template and is removed on a real case study. The four steps use the Brand DNA names (Understand, Plan, Build, Run and grow). Results follow the price-claim rules: a Source key on each figure, a dated source line, approval by the partner. One Primary (the closing band); the hero has none, the header keeps its Secondary outline and no nav item is marked current. The ribbon appears twice: the Steps component and the rule in the closing band. Build 2026-11-03: both frames pass the lint (node 37:851) with no findings, before and after the last text edits; the mobile frame has no layer wider than 390. Headings and the quote were set on balanced lines by hand (in code, text-wrap: balance). No existing background is used, so the template adds no repeated image.
